name: sori
description: Sori: podcasts and YouTube into transcripts, then into training decks.

plugins.name: sori
plugins.description: Sori from Claude Code or Cowork: /sori:transcribe (one episode or video, free, local), /sori:shows (subscriptions and settings), /sori:sweep (every Auto show, headless), /sori:train (transcript to training deck + study guide; free by default, the API route is optional and paid).
